name: Instagram Social
shortInfo: Instagram Professionals can manage their presence on Instagram
brief: Instagram Social provides resources for Instagram Businesses and Creators who need insight into, their social media interactions.
about:
DataChannel’s Instagram Social Connector enables streaming relevant Instagram metadata and metrics data into a user determined warehouse.

Check more about Instagram api documentation [here](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api).
availableData:
[Daily User Interaction Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines/daily-user-interaction-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the total number of post interactions, story interactions, reels interactions, video interactions and live video interactions, including any interactions on boosted content; aggregated by day.

[Media](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines/media.html)  
This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve fields and edges on an Instagram Media.

[Media Comments](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines/media-comments.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of Instagram comments on an Instagram Media object.

[Reels Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines/reels-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve metrics on the reels media type.

[Story Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines/story-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve metrics on the story media type.

[User Stories](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines/user-stories.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of story Instagram Media objects on an Instagram User.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/instagram-social/pipelines.html) here.
